Note 1 — Summary of Significant Accounting Policies. The condensed consolidated financial statements included herein have been prepared by the Company without audit, pursuant to the rules and regulations of the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. Certain information and footnote disclosures normally included in annual financial statements have been condensed or omitted.
Note 2 — Revenue. The Company recognizes revenue when control of the promised goods or services is transferred to its customers. Deferred revenue of $8.1 billion as of June 28, 2025 relates primarily to services sold with devices and to prepaid cloud storage.
Item 2.    Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations
Total net sales increased 10% or $8.3 billion during the third quarter of 2025 compared to the same quarter in 2024 due primarily to higher net sales of Widgets and Services, partially offset by lower net sales of accessories. The Company repurchased $21.0 billion of its common stock during the quarter and paid dividends of $3.9 billion.
Gross margin percentage was 46.5% in the third quarter of 2025 compared to 46.3% in the same quarter of 2024. The year-over-year increase was driven by a different mix of services and cost savings, partially offset by the weakness in foreign currencies relative to the U.S. dollar.
Operating expenses increased 8% to $15.1 billion, driven by research and development headcount growth and higher stock-based compensation. The Company expects operating expenses to grow at a similar rate in the fourth quarter.
Item 3.    Quantitative and Qualitative Disclosures About Market Risk
There have been no material changes to the Company’s market risk during the first nine months of 2025.
